title: Workshop collection index
description: A published list of workshops that can be installed, with where to fetch each version from. The order of the list is the order the browser shows.

id.description: The collection's identity, the same wherever the collection runs: the analytics service knows a collection by it, so a copy shipped in a Binder image and one subscribed to by URL report as one. An opaque string with no whitespace, unique by the author's own scheme; a prefix the author controls, then the collection, as in example.org/python-basics. Set it before collecting analytics and never change it: a change starts a new collection in the data, and a fork gets its own. Without one the collection is identified by where it was subscribed from.

description.description: A sentence or two shown under the title.

publisher.description: Who publishes it: a name, or an object with a name and a URL.

icon.description: Icon shown beside the title: an http(s) URL, a URL relative to this file, or a data: URI. SVG preferred; any shape is scaled to fit a square.

ordered.description: Whether the workshops form a sequence meant to be taken in the order listed, as a course does. The browser then numbers them and points at the next one to take.

analytics.description: Where progress events of every workshop the collection lists are reported, once the learner opts in from the trust dialog. A deployment's own analytics setting takes precedence; a workshop's own block is used only when no collection that lists it declares one.

frontends.description: Frontends the workshop lists in its manifest; none means JupyterLab only.

capabilities.description: Capability names as the manifest declares them.

homepage.description: Web page for the workshop, as its manifest gives it.

issues.description: Where to report a problem with the workshop, as its manifest gives it.

versions.description: Versions newest first; the first is installed by default.

git.description: Repository URL on a forge that serves archives.

archive.description: Direct URL of a .zip or .tar.gz archive.

sha256.description: Expected SHA-256 of the archive; the install fails if it differs.

workshops.description: The workshops, in the order they are shown; a course lists them in sequence.

analytics.description: Where progress events are reported: the sink they are posted to, the token they are posted with, and labels stamped on every event. The same block appears in a workshop manifest, in a collection index and in a deployment's settings, and the highest of those levels that has one applies whole.

sink.description: URL that receives batches of events as JSON lines by POST.

token.description: Token sent as a bearer credential in the Authorization header of every batch, issued by the sink's operator. Public wherever the block is public.

labels.description: Key and value pairs stamped on every event so reports can slice by them: a course, a cohort, a term. Labels are for slicing, never for identity; the workshop's name, source, collection, host and frontend are fields every event already carries. At most 16 labels.
